answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond and earn reputation only through verified, costly work over time, so creating many fake identities becomes expensive: a single raven can scout, but it cannot fake a whole flock history. Like a mesa that rises only after long erosion, trust should accumulate slowly and be slashed on fraud, while honest work yields nectar in the form of fees and access, making Sybil farming unprofitable.
